277980101.description: This lot includes three mineral specimens: two natural geodes and one polished blue agate slice. The first geode is whole with a rough tan exterior. The second geode is split open, revealing white quartz crystals inside a light brown rocky shell. The third specimen is a polished blue agate slice with banded patterns and a crystalline core. All pieces are raw, unmounted, and show natural surface texture and mineral inclusions. These 3pc crystal gemstone lot features raw druzy calcite quartz geodes and a blue bookend agate slice, suitable for collectors, display, or educational use.
